exposure: cesarean deliveries of infants with a confirmed gestational age of less than thirty-nine weeks
outcome: Rate of early elective deliveries among Medicaid singleton births
Trends in early elective delivery rates
cohort: Medicaid beneficiaries who gave birth to singletons between 2010 and 2012 in 22 participating states
finding: An estimated 160,000 early elective Medicaid deliveries occur nationwide each year, representing 8.9% of all Medicaid singleton births.
mod_finding: This study found that 8.9% of Medicaid singleton births were early elective deliveries, defined as non-medically indicated labor inductions or cesarean deliveries before 39 weeks.
